name: Portfolio Identification 3
definition: Identifies the portfolio if the collateral is reported on a portfolio basis.

Code.name: Code
Code.definition: Unique code determined by the reporting counterparty to identify the portfolio if collateral is reported on a portfolio basis.

PortfolioTransactionExemption.name: Portfolio Transaction Exemption
PortfolioTransactionExemption.definition: Indicates whether the collateral portfolio includes transactions exempt from reporting.||Usage: If the element is not present, the PortfolioTransactionExemption is False.
